title: slugify
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function slugify(str) that:
- lowercases
- replaces any run of spaces or punctuation (anything not a-z, 0-9) with a single hyphen
- strips leading/trailing hyphens
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: isPalindrome
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function isPalindrome(str) that returns true if str is a palindrome
ignoring case, spaces, and punctuation (keep only a-z0-9). Empty string is true.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: chunk
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function chunk(arr, size) that splits arr into arrays of length size.
The last chunk may be shorter. If size < 1, return []. Do not mutate arr.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: parseQuery
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function parseQuery(qs) that parses a URL query string into an object of strings.
Ignore a leading '?'. Duplicate keys: last value wins. decodeURIComponent values.
Empty input returns {}. Do not use URLSearchParams if you prefer a small parser — either is fine.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: deepGet
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function deepGet(obj, path) where path is a dot-separated string (e.g. "a.b.0.c").
Numeric path segments are array indexes. Missing path returns undefined.
Empty path returns obj itself.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: uniquePreserve
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function uniquePreserve(arr) that returns a new array of unique primitive values,
keeping the first occurrence (case-sensitive). Do not mutate arr.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: formatBytes
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function formatBytes(n) for n >= 0:
- 0 => "0 B"
- 1024 => "1 KB"
- 1536 => "1.5 KB"
- 1048576 => "1 MB"
Use 1024-based units B, KB, MB, GB. If the value is an integer after converting, omit decimals (1 KB not 1.0 KB).
Otherwise one decimal place. Space before the unit.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: rangeSum
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function rangeSum(a, b) that returns the sum of all integers from a to b inclusive.
a and b may be in either order and may be negative.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: titleCase
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function titleCase(str) that capitalizes the first letter of each word and lowercases the rest.
Collapse any whitespace to a single space and trim. Empty => "".
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: isAnagram
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function isAnagram(a, b) that returns true if a and b are anagrams,
ignoring case and spaces (keep letters and digits only). Two empty strings are true.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: fibonacci
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function fibonacci(n) for the n-th Fibonacci number (0-indexed: 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, ...).
If n is negative, return null. n is an integer.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.

title: groupBy
prompt:
Write a JavaScript function groupBy(arr, key) that groups an array of objects by obj[key].
Return an object whose values are arrays of the original objects, in original order.
Empty arr => {}. Do not mutate arr.
Return ONLY a markdown javascript code fence with the function. No tests, no explanation.
